strongest_angle: Examining the October 2026 LLM API market shifts across tracking platforms, including Model Price Watch reporting a frontier intelligence cost of $5.14 per million tokens on October 1, 2026, and Sovyron recording 1629 API price changes.

key_facts.fact: On October 1, 2026, frontier intelligence cost $5.14 per million tokens according to Model Price Watch tracking across 10 flagship models.
Sovyron recorded 1629 API price changes across 333 models in the 30 days leading up to October 30, 2026.
Google's Gemini 4 Argon model was scheduled on the apiprice platform for December 1, 2026, with an input price moving from $2 to $4.
